description: The booking pipeline as lifecycle lanes (Proposal sent [lane key 'quote'], Contract & deposit [key 'contract'], Confirmed, Balance due, Lost). Each lane lists its bookings with totals, paid and balance; Contract & deposit bookings carry open_steps — any of send_contract (your move), awaiting_signature, deposit_due. Stage is computed from the booking's state.
